title: KeyConditioner and PowerlineShield — HPF/LPF/emphasis, hum notches, auto-detect
description:
Implement key-path pre-conditioning and Powerline Shield as audio-thread-safe DSP units that never alter audible tone (key path only).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md sections 5.1–5.6 (HPF/LPF, emphasis, Powerline Shield coeffs, hum immunity, key listen)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h key filter / hum / listenMode IDs
- Source/DSP/KeySourceRouter.* API shape from b.1 if present (for naming consistency only)

Implement Source/DSP/KeyConditioner.h/.cpp:
- Adjustable HPF 20–250 Hz, 12 or 24 dB/oct (cascaded biquads for 24).
- Optional LPF 1.5–20 kHz, 12 or 24 dB/oct.
- Detector emphasis: broad bell/bandpass with frequency, bandwidth/Q, gain; optional solo-key-path flag for listen routing helpers.
- Key listen mode selectors for audition routing metadata: raw key, conditioned key (aligned/transient/sustain hooks may be stubs/enums for later phases).
- prepare/reset/process mono key buffer in place or to an output buffer; coefficient updates smoothed or done on param change off the hot path as needed, no allocations in process.

Implement Source/DSP/PowerlineShield.h/.cpp:
- Hum rejection notches at 50 Hz or 60 Hz mode plus off/auto; first harmonic required, optional 2nd/3rd harmonics; adjustable Q.
- Standard notch biquad from spec:
  w0=2*pi*f0/fs; alpha=sin(w0)/(2*Q);
  b0=1, b1=-2*cos(w0), b2=1; a0=1+alpha, a1=-2*cos(w0), a2=1-alpha.
- Auto-detect compares energy near 50 vs 60 Hz and checks harmonic consistency; expose chosen mode + confidence.
- Hum immunity estimate for detector confidence:
  E_musical = max(0, E_key - eta * E_hum) with configurable eta.
- process applies notches to key path only.

Do NOT edit CMakeLists.txt (b.3 owns it). Do NOT implement KeySourceRouter or DetectorEngine.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: KeyConditioner provides HPF 20–250 Hz at 12/24 dB/oct, optional LPF 1.5–20 kHz at 12/24 dB/oct, and emphasis bell/bandpass controls
KeyConditioner exposes key listen mode selection metadata for raw/conditioned (and stub enums for later key types)
PowerlineShield implements 50/60/off/auto hum notches with fundamental plus optional 2nd/3rd harmonics using the specified biquad coefficients
PowerlineShield auto-detect compares 50 Hz vs 60 Hz energy with harmonic consistency and reports confidence
PowerlineShield provides hum-immunity E_musical = max(0, E_key - eta * E_hum)
No heap allocation in per-block process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: apply conditioning to the audible output path

allowed: implement biquads manually or with juce::IIRFilter / juce::dsp::IIR
cascade two 12 dB stages for 24 dB/oct
keep auto-detect analysis on a slow path / decimated counters while notches stay per-sample
